sources.title: TRELLIS.2: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
sources.snippet: Our 4B-parameter model generates high-resolution fully textured assets with exceptional fidelity and efficiency with vanilla DiTs. * Total generation time (shape + material). ** Tested with NVIDIA H100 GPU.
